svg.title: Four Checks Before Accepting a Live Assignment
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-statutory-risk-checks; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Accepting a Live Assignment; subtitle: A failed applicable check routes the order to remediation, not dispatch.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Apply checks in sequence to the actual service. Passenger-only work does not inherit specimen-shipping requirements. Document why a conditional requirement does or does not apply.; caption: Proceed only when the assigned provider, information workflow, service evidence, and handling method support the contracted work.; stages: label: Payer and provider eligibility; value: Yes: continue; no: obtain required credentials and authorization; numeric value: 1.0; detail: For Medicaid work, verify state and broker enrollment, driver and vehicle requirements, exclusions screening, and trip authorization under applicable program rules. 42 CFR 431.53 and 440.170(a) establish context, not universal broker payment eligibility.; label: Worker status and insured capacity; value: Yes: continue; no: redesign staffing or replace capacity; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Evaluate actual control and applicable labor tests under 29 U.S.C. 203 and state law, including California Labor Code section 2775 where relevant. Verify commercial coverage for the assigned service; a 1099 label or insurance certificate alone does not resolve exposure.; label: Protected information handling; value: Yes: continue; no: repair access controls and required agreements; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Determine business-associate status under 45 CFR 160.103; execute required agreements under 164.502(e) and 164.504(e). Restrict dispatch access to necessary information. A courier conduit analysis does not automatically extend to a platform storing protected health information.; label: Specimen classification and exposure controls; value: Yes: release; no: correct packaging or select qualified service; numeric value: 4.0; detail: For specimen work, confirm classification before applying 49 CFR 173.199 Category B packaging and marking rules; Category A material needs a different workflow. Apply 29 CFR 1910.1030 to covered employee exposure and follow laboratory handling instructions under 42 CFR 493.1242.

rect.title: label: Protected information handling; value: Yes: continue; no: repair access controls and required agreements; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Determine business-associate status under 45 CFR 160.103; execute required agreements under 164.502(e) and 164.504(e). Restrict dispatch access to necessary information. A courier conduit analysis does not automatically extend to a platform storing protected health information.
